description: races: List a race's events. GET /v1/races/events. Lists the distances of a race and the ids /v1/races/results needs. runsignup: pass race_id; every finished event of the race is listed, each with its event_id. athlinks: pass event_id (an edition from /v1/races/search); its courses are listed with course_id. raceroster: pass event_id (a results code or a numeric event id); its races are listed with course_id. An empty list costs 0 credits. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 0 credits when events is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Serve a cached response when it is newer than this. A cache hit costs 0 credits.

event_id.description: athlinks and raceroster: the event id.

platform.description: Timing platform: runsignup, athlinks (also carries ChronoTrack events) or raceroster.

race_id.description: runsignup only: the RunSignup race id.

name: races_events
